quote: The driver of a vehicle shall not make a U-turn in a business district, except at an intersection or on a divided highway where an appropriate opening or crossing place exists.

activation.condition: A driver makes a U-turn in a source-reviewed business district.

obligation.description: The driver shall not make that U-turn unless the stated intersection or divided-highway exception applies.

exceptions.trigger: The full U-turn occurs at an independently reviewed intersection.
exceptions.effect: Intersection location is the stated alternative to the district prohibition.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: No categorical legal verdict follows from the CPU package.

exceptions.trigger: A divided highway has an appropriate opening or crossing place.
exceptions.effect: This alternative needs a different physical layout and a source-backed review.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: No categorical legal verdict follows from this fixed intersection cell.
exceptions.source_clause: on a divided highway where an appropriate opening or crossing place exists

timing.description: Original 20 Hz source frames cover approach, full reversal, other-vehicle motion and post-turn observation.

parameter_refs.name: turn_location
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: within reviewed intersection boundary or before it

parameter_refs.name: ego_route
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed connected U-turn route inside intersection or on approach
